OPEN_TABLE.description: Open Result Table (OPEN_TABLE). Opens a post-processing result table in the result view; driven by the single TABLE_TYPE field naming which result table to open.

TABLE_TYPE.description: Table Type to open in the result view (e.g. DISPLACEMENTG, BEAMFORCE, REACTIONG). Resolved against the same registry as post/TABLE (__caTableTypeMap, uppercase + strip-spaces) but restricted to RESULT tables: it must exist AND have GetDSKindByType>0 (a post/design result). Input tables (SECTION*, MATERIAL, FLOORLOADS, NODALBODYFORCE, SUPPORTS) have DSKind=0 and are rejected ('is not a post result table'). Story/seismic tables (STORY_*, STORY_DRIFT_*) are MIDAS Gen (_MGEN) only and do NOT exist on this Civil endpoint ('Unknown TABLE_TYPE'). Empty value is rejected (LV_WRONG_FIELD). Use requestinfo/POST/TABLE/TYPELIST to enumerate valid types for the running model.
